title: Three-template retained-support event probabilities
question: Can three fixed candidate templates compute complete qualified event sums with explicit numerical and resource outcomes?
method: Independent hand-calculated numerical fixtures, pure operation controls, malformed-input reproductions/repair, independent source review and main-tree54-test endpoint.
conclusion: 54 focused tests passed after root integration, independent reviewer closed malformed-input P2 on exact repaired hashes. Scores are provisional and exact only relative to retained support/floating-point arithmetic.
